correctness.rationale: Bloch matrix composition and invariant pure direction are derived exactly. Unit vectors averaging to a unit vector must all coincide, forcing the Clifford support into one coset. Proper signed-permutation point stabilizers are precisely cyclic orders 1,2,3,4. In a transverse right-handed orthonormal frame the map becomes multiplication by the complex number z; the allowed coset is a regular h-gon and yields both directions with explicit barycentric mixtures. Axis-orbit azimuths prove the phase-gate corollary; body-diagonal p=3/4 boundary comes from triangle real slice. Endpoints included. Independent finite LP comparisons of all 24 Clifford vertices agree in 88 cases; no finite test is treated as proof.

value.rationale: The prior tilted-dephasing work motivates identifying noise strengths and axes where arbitrary-depth Clifford-only unitary unravelings exist. The theorem gives a complete exact group-geometric classification of continuous axes, rotations, and noise probabilities with a sharp tilted-axis impossibility and a genuinely threefold symmetry transition. It is a structurally motivated classification, not a numerical recomputation or a generic textbook deduction. Applications must not be generalized to nonunitary Kraus instruments, full nonzero-cost optimization, or quantum fault-tolerance thresholds.
